name: Plex Watch State Migration
description: Migrate watched flags and resume positions from a Plex server into Matinee, per user. Covers the owner and Plex Home users, external shared accounts cannot be read.
author: Anna Reber

config.label: Connect Plex account
config.description: Shows a code to enter at https://plex.tv/link. The Connection row updates once the link completes.

config.label: Plex token (manual fallback)
config.description: Optional: paste an owner X-Plex-Token instead of using the link flow.

config.label: Users to migrate
config.description: Leave empty to migrate the owner and every Plex Home user that matches a Matinee account. Save after changing the selection.

config.label: User mapping overrides
config.description: Comma-separated remoteUser=matineeUser pairs for accounts whose names differ, e.g. john=johnny, kids=children.

config.label: Full sync: mirror the source exactly (may unwatch items in Matinee)
config.description: Off (default): only set watched flags and resume positions, never unwatch.
